title: Spicy Malaysian Chicken Fajitas
description: A quick and flavorful Mexican dish featuring chicken, peanuts, and a hint of Malaysian spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of fry oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of fry oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced bell peppers and onions to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the fajita seasoning to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and seasoning.
Stir in the Malaysian peanut sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the chicken and vegetables hot, garnished with sliced quick almonds.
Serve with your favorite Mexican dishes, such as tortillas, rice, and beans.
